title: Plesen': a game about mining, automation and mould :)
author: Necessary_Weight
selftext:
So, I always liked some aspects of games but not others. In Domekeeper and that game where you crawl vertically along the wall in like a steam walking machine and dig sideways, I liked the digging part. But running to the freaking dome to defend it or whatnot, not my thing.

I liked Factorio very much. Like 100s of hours much. But the whole thing was too complex for my brain. Why so many options? Why not universal smelter?

I played loads of automation games. I love them. But I want to shoot shit with all those resources, not make funny shapes of combine coloured blocks.

So I took the bits I liked, and Astra and I are building Plesen' in Codex.
